## ⚠️ IMPORTANT

**Do not use GitHub to report security vulnerabilities.**

Please email **security@runink.org** with details instead.

Include:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact assessment
- Suggested fix (if you have one)

We will respond within 48 hours and work with you on a fix.

---

If you're opening this issue by accident, please close it and email security@runink.org instead.

Thank you for helping keep River secure!
